shots.title: Only auto-promote a scorecarded sprint to complete from an in-flight status; report a conflict otherwise (#660)

hazards.description: The roadmap `status` field is free-form (no enum). PROMOTABLE_TO_COMPLETE ('', planned, active, in_progress, ready_for_pr) was empirically grounded against the repo's own sources (only in_progress/planned occur as in-flight), but a future novel in-flight status would be treated as a conflict until added. Safe failure direction (refuse + point at override), not silent overwrite.

shots.notes: completeRoadmapSourceSprint gained a force option and a PROMOTABLE_TO_COMPLETE guard: a scorecard on a sprint with a deliberate status (absorbed/blocked/deferred/superseded/cancelled/skipped) returns skipped:'status_conflict' with the authored status and writes nothing. Conflict re-checked under the .federation lock for TOCTOU safety. A scorecard records how a sprint was played, not whether it completed.

shots.title: Report the status conflict in slope validate instead of silently rewriting the source (#660)
shots.notes: reconcileModularRoadmapSources now surfaces skipped:'status_conflict' as a visible warning ('left as-authored ... status 'absorbed'') plus the 'slope roadmap complete --sprint=N' override hint, and continues. A scorecard for a deliberately-dispositioned sprint is a legitimate state, so validate still passes. Exported the helper for focused coverage.

shots.title: Keep slope roadmap complete as the explicit override for a deliberate status (#660)
shots.notes: completeSourcesSubcommand passes force:true so the operator can intentionally mark a deliberate-status sprint complete. This is the escape hatch validate points at; the automatic path never forces.

shots.title: Stop offering a deferred sprint as the next sprint to work on (#660)

hazards.description: One test miscalibration self-caught in-flight: the already-complete no-op case asserted changed:false, but the non-dry-run write path hardcodes changed:true (pre-existing). Split into a dryRun assertion. No shipped defect.

shots.notes: isRoadmapSprintPending now excludes deferred (via ROADMAP_DEFERRED_STATUSES) as well as terminal statuses, so next-sprint pickers, rollover target, and current-sprint inference skip a postponed sprint. deferred stays non-terminal (slope now labels it 'deferred'; reactivatable by editing back to planned/active). All 6 callers reviewed; full suite green.

bunker_locations: src/cli/roadmap-source-store.ts completeRoadmapSourceSprint: auto-promotion to complete must gate on an in-flight status set; the write path also hardcodes changed:true so callers cannot infer whether anything actually changed from the non-dry-run result.
src/core/roadmap.ts isRoadmapSprintPending vs isRoadmapSprintTerminal: deferred is deliberately non-terminal but non-selectable; the two predicates are not complements.
notes: Fixes #660 end-to-end: slope validate no longer back-propagates scorecard completion over a deliberate authored status, destroying absorbed/blocked/deferred/superseded history and inflating completion stats. Ships as v1.64.1 patch (no schema change, no new commands). Architect review (self, workflow-architecture lane): APPROVED — docs/retros/sprint-259-architect-review.md. Verified against the built CLI: validate reports the conflict and preserves 'absorbed'; roadmap complete forces the override.
